---
name: Specification or capability change
about: Propose a schema, rule, patch, CLI or Skill contract change.
title: ''
---

## Current contract and concrete failure

Identify affected versions, fields, rule/capability IDs and a sanitized reproduction.

## Proposed meaning

Explain the intended before/after semantics, including Unknown/Unverified states, units, references and human-decision provenance where relevant.

## Compatibility and migration

Describe old-reader behavior, versioning, extension preservation, required migration/backup work and unsupported cases. Do not invent a prior released format.

## Validation and decision

List affected fixtures, golden outputs, platforms/hosts and security boundaries. Link an ADR for broad architecture or public-contract changes. A proposal does not enable the capability.
